integrity_note: Proof via exact vacancy-chain reduction, predictable pairwise coupling and elementary Poisson approximation; finite exact enumerations are diagnostic. Originality is relative to inspected literature, not guaranteed historical priority. Full texts of several nearby specialist sources were unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Complete-graph irreversible homogeneous monomer/dimer kinetics; weak monomer rates at most 1/4, with asymptotics restricted to rates tending to zero. The result is about terminal monomer counts, not an equilibrium Gibbs monomer–dimer model or geometrically embedded substrates.
title: A parity-repaired Poisson crossover for competitive monomer–dimer adsorption on complete graphs
